record.title: 启动脚本未导出 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 致 libapriltag.so 加载失败
record.summary: launch-verification.sh 收了原生库目录却未导出给子进程，libapriltag.so 不在链接器搜索路径，三项测试全部失败。
record.content_json: {"evidence_refs":["sha256:4cfde6905dfc6e7b7f5664c34d11d31ae6df0ceb46a4376f2fc5f5c149c7b4cd"],"files":[],"learned":"exec 前加 export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=\"$native_dir${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}\"；换库改 native_dir 指新库 site-packages/<pkg>","relates_to":[],"what":"launch-verification.sh 收了原生库目录却未导出给子进程，libapriltag.so 不在链接器搜索路径，三项测试全部失败。","where":"来源档案 am-347d912831feb751855892df；固定提交 343c60fd2309dbf1edf6d3169b80838c54e1f1cd；workspace 内 launch-verification.sh（apriltag-python 3.4.5 验证启动脚本）。","why":"musl 下 DT_NEEDED 只按动态链接器搜索路径解析；wheel 未嵌 RPATH，PYTHONPATH、运行时改 os.environ、预加载都无效。"}
